digest.en: Middle East & Africa leads the board this hour with UN experts urge UAE to free British businessman. 25 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर दुनिया की अगुवाई है, फाइनल में चुनौती पेश कर रहे पैरा तैराक बुडिगिना-इमाम, मुक्केबाज जादूमणि अगले दौर में मुख्य खबर है। साथ ही मध्य पूर्व और अफ्रीका से भी घटनाक्रम सामने आया है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: UN experts urge UAE to free British businessman
articles.summary: Ryan Cornelius, 72, was jailed in 2008 over a financing dispute and completed his 10-year sentence in 2018, but remains in prison after his term was extended by 20 years over an alleged unpaid debt. UN experts urge UAE to free British businessman.

articles.title: Israeli military kills four Palestinians after settler killed in West Bank
articles.summary: Two other Israelis and four more Palestinians were wounded, health officials said, and the Israeli military announced it was preparing for an “extensive” counterterror operation in the West Bank, with troops surrounding the town of Nablus Israeli military kills four Palestinians after settler killed in West Bank.

articles.title: ICICI Bank prices $1 billion debt at tighter spread
articles.summary: The bank set the ​coupon at 100 basis points over U. S. Treasuries, sharply ⁠lower the initial guidance of 130 basis points, for its first dollar debt sale in nearly nine years. The coupon works out to be ‌5.46%. ICICI Bank prices $1 billion debt at tighter spread.

articles.title: Guyanese authorities confirm death of 72 people in sinking of coastal ferry
articles.summary: Guyanese authorities confirm 72 deaths after a state ferry capsized off the coast, leaving 179 people aboard. Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 were rescued as efforts continue to salvage the ship and recover all bodiesThe confirmed death toll from the recent capsizing of a state ferry off Guyana’s coast has risen to 72, with more bodies recovered as a multinational team struggle to salvage the partially submerged vessel. Of the estimated 179 people aboard, 76 people were rescued.

articles.title: Iran-Iraq-Pakistan ‘axis of sympathy’ signals a reshaping Southwest Asia
articles.summary: Earlier this month, the Supreme Leader of Iran, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, was buried in his hometown of Mashhad after a four-day ceremony. Many international delegations were present, but each country will have chosen their representatives with the utmost care. Sending high-ranking officials would go beyond mere diplomatic courtesy, and possibly signal an alliance. articles.title: In El Obeid, Sudanese women face drones by day, rape by night, to reach water
articles.summary: In El Obeid, women and girls now face an impossible choice over something as basic as a bucket of water: risk a drone strike by collecting it in daylight, or risk rape by waiting until dark. In El Obeid, Sudanese women face drones by day, rape by night, to reach water.

articles.title: Masked men invading and taking Amazon communities ‘hostage’ in organised crime surge, say local
articles.summary: Delegation sent to Brasília after gunmen from organised crime group enter homes in western Amazon ForestIndigenous leaders on the Brazil-Peru border say their communities are being “taken hostage” by organised crime groups who are running rampant across the region, destroying Amazon Forest, building roads and trafficking drugs. Earlier this month, masked men armed with semi-automatic weapons entere Gangs taking villages on Brazil-Peru border ‘hostage’, say Indigenous leaders.

articles.title: Ukraine Hits More Wildberries Warehouses Near St. Petersburg, Occupied Crimea
articles.summary: Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics hubs near St. Petersburg and in occupied Crimea, causing fires and disruptions. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine also hit a key military facility in Russia’s Kirov region that supplies components for aircraft and missile systems. Ukraine Hits More Wildberries Warehouses Near St. Petersburg, Occupied Crimea.

articles.title: Wildberries, 'Russia's Amazon,' Hit Again In New Wave Of Ukrainian Strikes
articles.summary: Ukraine struck targets in several parts of Russia early on July 24, including another warehouse of Russian e-commerce retailer Wildberries, as Kyiv continues to expand its retaliatory long-range strike campaign in an effort to force Moscow into negotiations. Wildberries, 'Russia's Amazon,' Hit Again In New Wave Of Ukrainian Strikes.

articles.title: Iranians find community in art, culture and memes as missiles fly
articles.summary: Coverage of the conflict between Iran, Israel and the United States has largely focused on battlefield developments, political statements and international diplomacy. However, another story has been unfolding on the streets of Iran. Despite fears of further military escalation dominating daily life, residents continue to take up space, both in person and online. articles.title: Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Red Sea
articles.summary: Islamabad has condemned attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels on Saudi-flagged vessels in the Red Sea. It also warned that any aggressive actions toward Pakistan-flagged vessels or the country's maritime interests would be regarded as a “grave threat” that may result in “lawful use of force.” Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Read Sea. Saudi Ally Pakistan Issues Warning After Houthi Attacks On Tankers In Red Sea.

articles.title: On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk
articles.summary: Ukrainian drone-interceptor crews are working around the clock to stop Russian reconnaissance and attack drones approaching the frontline city of Kramatorsk. RFE/RL spent a night with one team defending the skies as aerial attacks intensify. On The Front Line Of Ukraine's Drone War Over Kramatorsk.

articles.title: Iran urged to stop protest-related executions
articles.summary: Independent UN human rights investigators on Thursday called for Iran to immediately halt the execution of 10 men who took part in a protest in the central city of Isfahan earlier this year, warning that some of their relatives have already been called for final visits. Iran urged to stop protest-related executions.

articles.title: Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns
articles.summary: Food security and child nutrition have improved across the Gaza Strip largely due to a scale-up in humanitarian assistance and commercial traffic, but progress remains fragile and could quickly reverse without sustained access, funding and recovery support. Gaza’s food gains could unravel without sustained aid, UN warns.

articles.title: Stranded seafarers remain trapped as Hormuz shipping stalls
articles.summary: As the Iran-US war continues, the key question remains unanswered about how shipping through the Strait of Hormuz will be managed in future – although the UN has reiterated that charging tolls for safe passage runs contrary to international law. Stranded seafarers remain trapped as Hormuz shipping stalls.

articles.title: No Breakthroughs, Little Optimism As Rubio, Lavrov Meet On Ukraine War
articles.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said following talks with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov that the United States remains prepared to help broker an end to Russia's war in Ukraine but that fresh proposals would be needed after previous peace ideas failed. No Breakthroughs, Little Optimism As Rubio, Lavrov Meet On Ukraine War.

articles.title: Hasina’s return from India would imperil Bangladesh’s sovereignty
articles.summary: To say Bangladesh’s former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina left office in disgrace would be an understatement by any political measure. Ousted following the student-led uprising of August 2024, she fled the country after months of deadly protests and years of increasingly authoritarian rule marked by enforced disappearances, arbitrary arrests, the suppression of political opponents and [] The post H Hasina’s return from India would imperil Bangladesh’s sovereignty.

articles.title: Countless Ukrainians Need Prosthetics. Homegrown Start-Ups Are Supplying Them
articles.summary: As battlefield injuries mount from a long-running war, Ukrainian companies are racing to meet a high demand for prosthetic limbs. One start-up, Allbionics, is making sophisticated prosthetics that it offers to patients at no cost, with the help of government support and private donations. Countless Ukrainians Need Prosthetics. Homegrown Start-Ups Are Supplying Them.

articles.title: The real reasons behind Zelensky’s unpopular military purge
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky recently made the controversial decision to dismiss Mykhailo Fedorov, his minister of defense. Fedorov, admired both by Ukrainian troops and Western allies, was at the forefront of Ukraine’s increasing technological innovations in the war against Russia. According to Fedorov, however, tension began to emerge over his own desire to replace General [] The post The real reasons behind Zelensky’s unpopular military purge.

articles.title: Indonesia shouldn’t bet its nickel future on China’s EVs alone
articles.summary: Indonesia is building a battery industry and an EV ecosystem as part of its broader nickel downstreaming agenda. The objective is that downstreaming should not stop at smelters. It must move deeper into industrial components, machinery, batteries and, eventually, electric vehicles. Indonesia’s largest battery industrial hub reflects this ambition. But the battery industry itself is [] The post In Indonesia shouldn’t bet its nickel future on China’s EVs alone.

articles.title: Iran Executes Man Charged Over January Protests As Death Row Inmates Stage Hunger Strike
articles.summary: Iran has executed Mehdi Khaneki, a young man convicted on charges tied to anti-government protests that swept across the country in January. The execution came as some 1,500 death row inmates at the prison continued a hunger strike demanding an end to executions. Iran Executes Man Charged Over January Protests As Death Row Inmates Stage Hunger Strike.

articles.title: Iran Continues Executions Amid Protest By Death Row Inmates
articles.summary: Iran executed a man it accused of carrying out "operational actions" during nationwide protests at the start of the year as the country's leadership ratchets up its crackdown on dissent, sparking a hunger strike among hundreds of death row inmates. Iran Continues Executions Amid Protest By Death Row Inmates.

articles.title: Rubio Says Iran-Backed Houthis' Red Sea Blockade 'Problematic'
articles.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio ‌said on July 22 that a naval blockade of the Red Sea by Yemen’s Houthi rebels would be “problematic,” as the widening conflict with Iran disrupted two of the world’s most important energy chokepoints. Rubio Says Iran-Backed Houthis' Red Sea Blockade 'Problematic'.

articles.title: Deadly Afghanistan floods kill at least 26 as aid agencies race to reach survivors
articles.summary: Flash floods have killed at least 26 people across eastern Afghanistan, including 23 in the mountainous province of Nuristan, where homes, markets and roads were swept away and search teams continued looking for people reported missing. Deadly Afghanistan floods kill at least 26 as aid agencies race to reach survivors.

articles.title: लॉन्च होते ही रॉकेट से टकराई बिजली, फिर जो हुआ, देखकर फटी रह गई वैज्ञानिकों की आखें
articles.summary: चीन के शिचांग सेंटर से उड़ान भरते ही 'लॉन्ग मार्च-3बी' रॉकेट पर आसमान से कड़कड़ाती बिजली आ गिरी, जिससे एक पल के लिए लगा कि बड़ा हादसा हो जाएगा. इस चीनी रॉकेट ने बिना डगमगाए उड़ते रहकर सबको हैरान कर दिया और अपने 'तियानलियान-2-06' डेटा रिले सैटेलाइट को एकदम सही ऑर्बिट में पहुंचा दिया. आसमान से गिरने वाली लाखों वोल्ट की बिजली से अक्सर रॉकेट के कंप्यूटर और नेविगेशन जल जाते हैं, पर चीन के इस रॉकेट पर क।

articles.title: मोदी सरकार के इस मंत्री का प्रधानमंत्री की सलाह पर इस्तीफा, राष्ट्रपति द्रोपदी मुर्मू ने किया
articles.summary: रवनीत सिंह बिट्टू ने प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी की सलाह पर शुक्रवार को अपना इस्तीफा दे दिया। राष्ट्रपति द्रौपदी मुर्मू ने उनके इस्तीफे को तत्काल प्रभाव से स्वीकार कर लिया। राष्ट्रपति भवन ने आधिकारिक अधिसूचना जारी की। प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी के नेतृत्व वाली केंद्रीय कैबिनेट से रेल राज्य मंत्री का पद संभालने वाले रवनीत सिंह बिट्टू ने शुक्रवार (24 जुलाई, 2026) को अपना इस्तीफा दे दिया है.

articles.title: दुबई में पहचान वाला ढूंढिए और सस्ते में घूम आइए, UAE सरकार देगी VIP ट्रीटमेंट, कैश प्राइज भी मिलेगा!
articles.summary: अमेरिका, इजरायल और ईरान की जंग के डर से दुबई के मशहूर टूरिज्म बिजनेस पर बड़ा संकट आ गया है. 2025 में जहां करीब 2 करोड़ टूरिस्ट यहां घूमने आए थे, वहीं आज यहां सन्नाटा पसरा है, जिससे 7-स्टार होटलों को भारी छूट देनी पड़ रही है और उड़ानों का काम आधा रह गया है. इस मंदी से उबरने के लिए दुबई सरकार ने 'दुबई इनवाइट' स्कीम निकाली है, जिसमें यूएई में रहने वाले लोगों को अपने दोस्तों और रिश्तेदारों को दुबई बुल।

articles.summary: स्पेन में भीषण जंगल की आग ने हालात इतने बिगाड़ दिए हैं कि सरकार ने पहली बार वाइल्डफायर के कारण राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल घोषित कर दिया है. मैड्रिड और एविला के आसपास हजारों लोगों को सुरक्षित स्थानों पर भेजा गया है. इस बीच आग को फैलने से रोकने के लिए गधों का इस्तेमाल चर्चा में है. जंगल की आग से जूझ रहा स्पेन, बुझाने के लिए बुलाए गए गधे, देश में लगी इमरजेंसी।

articles.title: सऊदी-UAE का नया तेल रूट देखकर ज्यादा खुश ना हों! उल्टा बढ़ गई भारत की टेंशन, बम बनकर फटेगी ऑयल
articles.summary: होर्मुज जलडमरूमध्य (Strait of Hormuz) संकट के बीच भले ही दूसरे खाड़ी देश नए तेल रूट का जुगाड़ लगा रहे हैं. हालांकि, भारत की टेंशन खत्म होती नहीं दिख रही है. सऊदी अरब और UAE की नई तेल पाइप लाइन भारत के महंगाई बनकर फट सकती है. सऊदी अरब, यूएई और इराक अपनी तेल सप्लाई जारी रखने के लिए अरबों डॉलर की लागत से नई पाइपलाइनों का जाल बिछाकर लाल सागर और ओमान की खाड़ी का नया रास्ता अपना रहे हैं लेकिन खाड़ी देशो।
